crossRefs.note: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.
He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath…
He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

translations.web: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.
translations.bsb: One Sabbath Jesus was teaching in one of the synagogues,
translations.kjv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath.
translations.asv: And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath day.
